note: Ceiling for internal/controlplane, in hand-written non-test Go lines. Build-ignored tools and generated DO-NOT-EDIT output are reported but not counted; see scripts/report-migration-progress.mjs. The bounded-context migration may only move this down. Raising it requires saying why in the same commit.
reason: Lowered by 288 when Identity took ownership of what a credential has to prove. The OIDC claim policy -- issuer, audience, purpose and scope checks, the token-freshness bound, the claim shapes and their limits, and the configuration validation that refuses a policy it could not enforce exactly -- moved to internal/identity/domain and is now checkable against a claim literal with no key and no clock. Signature verification became an outbound adapter over one TokenVerifier port, and reading a credential off a request became an inbound one. The facade keeps the deployment configuration and three lines of wiring. The previous 25546 was recorded on 2026-08-15 for the Reporting slice, on the same counting basis.
